The package implements canonical audit bytes/hash chaining, monotonic append, synchronous head anchor, audit.read authorization/integrity failure, primary and emergency sink failure semantics, fenced crash recovery, legal hold, purge authorization/execution/verification, backup/restore non-resurrection, and zero committed/visible domain mutation on audit failure.

The package-owned verifier executes every unique GAT-* minimum vector in proposal section 18.1 and writes raw content-addressed evidence containing proposal, implementation, readiness, approval, selector, policy/rule, capability, environment, operation, expected, actual, side-effect, audit, and reviewer bindings.
